Data: BUS-CoT only; train/val from data/augmented_v5 (patient-grouped, near-duplicate frames joined); test = BUS-CoT official test split
Image preprocessing: ultrasound (CLAHE + border crop), 224 px; train-time horizontal flip, +/-10 degree rotation, brightness/contrast jitter
Image encoder: frozen; see the encoder table for each backbone (batch-7 runs add DINOv2 ViT-B/14 as the size-matched comparator for USFM)
Predictor: 6 transformer layers, width 1024, 16 heads, MLP ratio 4.0, dropout 0.1
Concept bottleneck: concept_dim 64; CB-3 heads: pathology, risk, birads; CB-9 heads: pathology, risk, birads, margins, shape, orientation, echogenicity, boundary, calcification
Decoder (encoder and bottleneck runs): stanford-crfm/BioMedLM (2.7B), full fine-tuning in Stage 2, 8 soft-prompt tokens, max length 512
Decoder sweep anchor: every sweep run starts Stage 2 from the Stage-1 checkpoint of CB-3 seed 1, so encoder, predictor, alignment and data are identical across sizes
Stage 1: epochs: at most 20; early stopping on val/loss, patience 4 (the schedule length is fixed by the epoch cap)
Stage 1: model selection: lowest val/loss at epoch end (best checkpoint kept, save_top_k=1)
Stage 2: epochs: at most 10; early stopping on val/loss, patience 3 (the schedule length is fixed by the epoch cap)
Stage 2: model selection: lowest val/loss at epoch end (best checkpoint kept, save_top_k=1)
Decoder sweep sizes: 0.5b: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, 1.5b: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, 3b: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, 7b: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, 14b: Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct [batch_size=8], 32b: Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct [batch_size=2], 72b: Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct [batch_size=2]
Decoder sweep quantization: bf16 for 0.5B-32B; 72B: 4-bit NF4 base with double quantization, bf16 compute (QLoRA), gradient checkpointing
Seeds: [1, 2, 3] for all runs except the 14B/32B/72B decoders (seed 1)
Decoding: beam search, 4 beams, max 256 new tokens, no sampling
VLM reference baselines: LoRA r=64, alpha=128, dropout 0.05 on q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj, gate_proj, up_proj, down_proj; lr 0.0001 cosine, warm-up 100, weight decay 0.01, bf16, gradient checkpointing; 2 epochs, per-device batch qwen25vl_7b 2, qwen2vl_7b 2, internvl3_8b 1 with 8-step accumulation; best checkpoint by validation loss; seeds 42 (trainer default), 2 and 3, which fixed data order and dropout but not adapter initialization; greedy decoding, max 256 new tokens
